claims.statement: The Pi SDK is consumed through a narrow PiSdkPort of five entry points (resolve the agent directory, build a resource loader, create a session manager, open a persisted transcript, create the session), loaded by dynamic import only when no port is injected, so unit tests run without credentials, a configured model or a terminal.

createEvidenceAgentSession initializes lazily on the first start, prompt or steer call, shares one in-flight start promise between concurrent callers, resets that promise after a failure so a retry is possible, and dispose unsubscribes from Pi, disposes the SDK session and clears the session, the start promise and every listener.

A session starts with the four authored instruction sections (role, modeling red lines, operators, workflow) appended to Pi's system prompt through a resource loader configured with noSkills: true, so no project or user directory is scanned for SKILL.md, and the desktop runtime adds no skillDirectories or instructions override; the prompt names only tools the desktop registers and contains no SKILL.md, .agents, references/ or shell-command relic.
Pi 的事件流被投影成恰好五种纯桌面事件（text-delta、tool-call-started、tool-call-completed、agent-settled、agent-error），其余 SDK 事件在这里丢弃，因此 renderer 可以把 transcript 截到末尾 8000 字符、把工具调用建模成活动列表，而无需 import SDK。

forkSessionLines keeps only the ancestor chain of a chosen transcript entry (or every entry when no fork point is given), records the source session as parentSession in a rewritten header, returns the leaf entry and the count of dropped sibling entries, and refuses missing headers, unparsable lines or unknown fork points with a typed SessionForkError while leaving the source lines untouched and terminating on a cyclic parent chain.

Pi 扩展按 TOOL_NAMES 注册 11 个工具；其中 4 个领域算子来自共享的 @evidence-poc/evidence-tools 注册表（与 apply_model_patch 同处 MODEL_TOOL_NAMES），执行时重新 loadDocument、用 createModelPatch 生成 RFC 6902 批次再交宿主 applyModelPatch，mutator 失败则一个补丁都不发送。
模型写入口在执行前用 Zod 校验输入，apply_model_patch 成功时把每个 op 名称列回模型，renderer 拒绝则转成 isError 以便下一轮自我修正，且不再接受旧的 typed commands。
补丁通道以 UUID 与 15 秒超时把主进程的请求关联到 renderer 的回答，renderer 再解析共享 schema 并一次 applyPatchBatch 提交到同一条撤销历史，只有文档真的变化才产生 before/after 审查。

The desktop agent runtime resolves the model root and project directory from the project's source form, creates one session with a single extension factory on the first prompt, and debounces background sensor runs (800 ms by default) so a burst of model edits produces one verdict.

Agent runtimes are keyed per project root and started single-flight so a second window joins the existing conversation, each runtime publishes events and reports only while its owning WebContents is alive and is disposed when that window is destroyed, and the runtime accepts a sessionFile to resume a persisted transcript even though no IPC path supplies one today.
测试覆盖 renderer 补丁拒绝结论原样回到工具、算子先读取模型树、以及被拒算子不发送任何补丁命令。
会话、工具、提示词、传感器、治理、trace reader 与 story 投影同属 evidence-agent，browser 子入口只导出类型与传感器报告 DTO（外加 trace/drift 纯审计函数），Node 会话运行时留在进程入口。
run_sensors 文本返回紧凑门禁投影，details 保存完整报告。
get_api_diff 只在副本试算 proposedPatches，sync_api_projection 只刷新诊断不改模型或发布基线。
协议条款分类与蓝图读取两个工具只读不写；蓝图解析失败时返回 isError 与失败摘要，而不是看起来成功的空草稿。

The same session factory serves a second harness consumer: ingestion runs one turn with a custom single instruction and noTools: 'all' in a scratch directory, folds the text stream into one reply, enforces a 120 s timeout and disposes the session, so a reading turn cannot grow .evidence files.

The runtime keeps a mirrored live document published by the renderer: notifyModelChanged validates the payload, rejects a foreign root or a revision that is not newer, preserves the first baseline, clears the cached verdict and re-arms the debounce, while runSensors publishes only the newest run's report tagged with the mirrored revision.

The renderer turns composer text into a prompt when idle and a steer while a run is streaming, and both the agent rail and the over-canvas card prefix that text with the chosen workshop step or the selected entity because the session keeps no such state of its own.
已应用的 agent 补丁变成一次可拒绝的审查：usePatchReview 用 diffDomainModels 比对 before/after，产出新增/修改/删除 id 与 canvas overlay，并且只在被补丁后的文档仍是屏幕上的文档时提供一步撤销。

The desktop passes customTools: [] but never tools or noTools, so Pi's built-in tool set stays available and the registered extensions are additions rather than a complete allowlist; keeping the model out of direct file writes therefore rests on the instructions and the reviewable patch path rather than on a sandbox.

readProductionTrace turns an OTLP/JSON export into Evidence commits keyed by fm.evidence.ref, silently passing over spans that name no Evidence and reporting spans that name Evidence without trace or span ids, so a malformed export yields empty commits plus path: message errors instead of throwing.
治理使用 drift 与外部 HTTP acceptance；空/畸形/失败验收要求修实现，只有无 blocking、非空全绿且 model_lagging 才可改模型。
独立治理指令以漂移和真实 HTTP 验收替代 replay；桌面默认建模指令不被该指令覆盖。
推理文本不进事件流：桌面把带推理模型的输出当普通文本转发，renderer 用 parseStreamedTranscript 从唯一一条 transcript 里取出第一个 <thought> 或 <thinking> 块，thinkingActive 表示开标签已到而闭标签未到，折叠时只露尾部 80 字符。
工具活动条目用中文标题映射已知工具，并保留原始工具名作为调用审计标识；未知工具回退到原名，展开后显示 JSON 入参。
行内协同卡在没有画布选择时拒绝发问只显示提示，有选择时把问题写成“关于 label（kind）：正文”；没有待处理补丁时它用 capture 阶段 Escape 关闭自己并 stopPropagation，避免同时清掉被讨论的选区。
